answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay before they can wander the market. To anchor an identity, an agent deposits 20 credits as a sunk, non-refundable tax; the tax is burned, not held, so nothing comes back on exit. A sybil spawning 1,000 hollow shells pays 20,000 credits and earns nothing, since empty shells earn no fees. An honest agent pays once, keeps its seat, and earns from real work without its share being diluted by cheap copies.
